chapter: Early years and the Sonny South
title: Swapping with Jeanette Kimball for Celestin's tours; end of Prohibition; playing support
summary: He swapped places with Jeanette Kimball so she toured with Celestin's band while he stayed in town with Sonny South. Prohibition's end hurt the big bands. He describes playing light, orchestrated rhythm piano.
